test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the highest mountain of Bhutan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangkhar Puensum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **With an elevation of 7,570 metres (24,836 feet) **and a prominence of 2,995 metres, **Gangkhar Puensum is Bhutan's highest mountain **and the world's highest unclimbed mountain.
 
• Its name means** "White Peak of the Three Spiritual Brothers."**
 
• It shares a border with Tibet. 
 
• A Japanese expedition ascended Liankang Kangri in 1999, a 7,535-meter (24,721-foot) subsidiary peak (not an independent summit) separated from the main peak by a 2-kilometre (1.2-mile) long ridge to the north-northwest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gipmochi** is a mountain in south-central Asia's Lower Himalayas. The peak, which rises to a height of 14,523 feet (4,427 metres), is located on the boundary between the Indian state of Sikkim and Bhutan.
 
• **Kangphu Kang,** also known as Shimokangri, is a Himalayan mountain. It is the world's 107th tallest peak, standing at 7,204 metres above sea level.
 
• **Chomolhari** is a Himalayan mountain that straddles the border between Tibet's Yadong County and Bhutan's Paro region.
